Item.Name: EQUIPMENT_TYPE
Item.Hint: Enter equipmnt type [LISTVAL] to edit existing data. Press [Enter] for new.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type is not null) then
 begin
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,14)
 into :ctrl_blk_1.s_equipment_desc
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'EQUIP'
 and mc.code = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Invalid equipment type');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 else
 go_block ('equipment');
 GO_ITEM ('equip_type');
 :equipment.in_service_date := trunc(sysdate);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 GO_ITEM ('equipment_id');
end;

Item.Name: EQUIPMENT_ID
Item.Hint: Input equipmnt ID [LISTVAL] to edit existing data. Press [Enter] for new.

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id is not null) then
 begin
 select 'X' into :global.x from equipment e
 where e.equip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id
 and e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* modified by HCL Consulting */
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 message ('No such ID for this equipment type');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 end;
 GO_ITEM ('equipment_ref');
 begin
 select e.equip_reference into :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_ref
 from equipment e
 where e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and e.equip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id
 and sysdate between nvl(e.in_service_date, sysdate+1) and
 nvl(e.out_service_date, sysdate+1)
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* modified by HCL Consulting */
 exception
 when too_many_rows then
 :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_ref := null;
 list_values;
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select max(e.equip_reference)
 into :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_ref
 from equipment e
 where e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and e.equip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* modified by HCL Consulting */
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('No machine with those parameters');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then null;
 end;
 end;
 else
 go_block ('equipment');
 :equipment.equip_type := :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type;
 select mc.code_desc into :equipment.s_equipment_name
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'EQUIP'
 and mc.code = :equipment.equip_type;
-- :equipment.in_service_date := trunc(sysdate);
 GO_ITEM ('equipment.equipment_type');
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: STATUS
Item.Hint: Enter the machines status. [ListVal] for valid statuses. [MENU] for bad events.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :GLOBAL.x := null;
 if (:equipment.status = 'IN') then
 begin
 begin
 select 'X' into :GLOBAL.x
 from equipment e
 where e.equip_type = :equipment.equip_type
 and e.equip_id = :equipment.equip_id
 and e.equip_reference != nvl(:equipment.equip_reference,0)
 and e.status = 'IN'
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* modified by HCL Consulting */
 exception when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 if (:GLOBAL.x = 'X' ) then
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS := null;
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS2 := null;
 message (
'Two machines of same type and ID cannot be in service simultaneously.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if (nvl(:equipment.in_service_date, sysdate-1) > trunc(sysdate))
 then
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS := null;
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS2 := null;
 message ('Future IN-SERVICE-DATE, Status cannot be IN');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if (nvl(:equipment.out_service_date,sysdate+1) < trunc(sysdate))
 then
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS := null;
 :EQUIPMENT.STATUS2 := null;
 message ('OUT-OF-SERVICE-DATE in past, STATUS cant be IN');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

end;

Trigger.Name: EQUIP_COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if(:SYSTEM.block_status != 'CHANGED') then
 message ('No changes to commit.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if (:equipment.inst_id is null) then
 :inst_id:=:global.inst_id;
 end if;
 if (:equipment.chapter_id is null) then
 :equipment.chapter_id:=:global.chapter_id; 
 end if;
 if (:equipment.equip_id is null) then
 GO_ITEM ('equip_id');
 message ('Equipment ID is a required field.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if (:equipment.status is null) then
 GO_ITEM ('status');
 message ('Equipment status is a required field.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if (:equipment.first_production_date is null) then
 GO_ITEM ('first_production_date');
 message ('First Production Date is a required field.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if (:equipment.equip_reference is null) then
 select 'EQ-'||substr(to_char(to_number(max(
 substr(equip_reference,4)))+1,'099999'),2,6)
 into :equipment.equip_reference
 from equipment;
 :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_ref:=:equipment.equip_reference;
 end if;
 GO_ITEM ('inst_id');
 :equipment.last_modified_date := sysdate;
 :equipment.modified_by := :banner.user_id;
 :equipment.program_id := 'EQIEQUIP';
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 show_error ('0000');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level :=0;
 message('Please note the equipment reference no '||:equipment.equip_reference);
 pause;
 clear_form;
 execute_trigger('sbc_banner');
end;
